newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB's Meyer says Swiss rates will rise some day.
newsitem.headline: SNB's Meyer says Swiss rates will rise some day.

text.p: Swiss National Bank chairman Hans Meyer was quoted by a Swiss newspaper on Friday as saying a time would come some day to tighten monetary policy.
Meyer also said the SNB's generous monetary policy had created a positive monetary environment for the economy and added he hoped signs of a recovery would appear soon.
Meyer told the Lucerne daily Neue Luzerner Zeitung the SNB would tighten policy when the time comes, a message the bank has been broadcasting for months.
"This point in time will certainly come," Meyer said.
The SNB has repeatedly said it expects to raise Switzerland's very low interest rates eventually when economic recovery gains a foothold after seven years of stagnation.
But the central bank has not yet said it sees signs of a significant recovery in the Swiss economy.
